stem.text: A box of weight $W$ is pulled by a force $P$ along a slope.
The length of the slope is $d$, and the box rises a height $h$.
The frictional force between the box and the slope is $F$.
The diagram shows the directions of the forces.

stem.alt: Box on an inclined slope with arrows labelled F, P and W. The slope length is labelled d and the vertical height is labelled h.

stem.text: The purpose of the slope is to raise the box vertically.
Which expression gives the efficiency of the slope?
